correctness.rationale: The factorization of the constant-term sequence modulo five gives a fully nonzero five-digit product, so ratios are defined at every index. The carry recursion is well-founded after solving the lag-one contraction. Coupling the carry at a length-5^k boundary gives O_h(1) ratio errors; character orthogonality and induction on lag give O_h(k) nontrivial joint Fourier sums; aligned block decomposition yields O_h(log^2 N). The exact 16-cell formula is derived by a one-step adjacent-pair recursion and verified independently for k≤12. A standalone verifier completed the reported finite reproducibility checks; finite evidence is not taken as infinite proof.

value.rationale: Two-point fixed-lag distribution and sharp finite-block bias are natural unresolved-looking refinements of the classical Lucas one-point congruence. The theorem covers every fixed nonnegative lag and gives a finite rational recursion; a nonuniform lag-two distribution and an exact sixteen-cell logarithmic adjacent bias reveal structure invisible in marginal equidistribution. The character and carry proofs add substantive arithmetic information beyond recoding a known table.
